paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples.

model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the performance of two methods—TrajICL and Full FT—measured by minFDE₂₀ (in meters) as a function of the percentage of the in-context example pool, ranging from 0.2 to 1.0 on a linear scale. The x-axis, labeled "Percentage of In-Context Example Pool," spans from 0.2 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "minFDE₂₀ (→)", ranges from 22 to 28 with tick marks every 2 units, indicating the prediction error in meters. The blue line with circular markers represents TrajICL, which starts at approximately 23.0 at 0.2 and gradually decreases to about 21.5 at 1.0, showing a consistent downward trend. The orange line with circular markers represents Full FT, which begins at approximately 29.0 at 0.2, dips to around 27.0 at 0.4, remains relatively flat until 0.8, and then declines to about 25.5 at 1.0. Both lines exhibit a decreasing trend in minFDE₂₀ as the percentage of in-context examples increases, though TrajICL consistently achieves lower error values than Full FT across all percentages.
